---
title: X6 React to a delay and a restriction
subtitle: Optional extension · self-paced · about 25 minutes
description: Re-plan after a two-week source delay and a rights restriction, choose and justify one option, keep the official deadline, and record the decision.
---

::: {.callout-tip title="Optional extension"}
The [core workflow](../syllabus.qmd#core) ends with X4. This exercise is an optional, self-paced extension. Start it in the block "Consolidate and extend", or later, when your thesis needs it. It uses the epic E08 from [X2](x2.qmd) and the Project and the milestones from [X3](x3.qmd). It does not need X5: if you have no release yet, the options refer to the planned release E08-T3. No assessment requires it.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
- **Time:** about 25 minutes
- **You produce:** two new sub-issues with dates, one dependency that follows from your decision, an unchanged submission milestone, a decision record, and a Project status update. Optional: an exported view.
- **New terms:** [dependency](../cheat-sheet.qmd#dependency), [milestone](../cheat-sheet.qmd#milestone), [view](../cheat-sheet.qmd#view). All terms are in the [cheat sheet](../cheat-sheet.qmd).
:::

## Why this step

Plans change. A good plan makes the change visible and traceable: what changed, why, what follows from it, and what did *not* change. In this exercise two events occur at once. There is no single correct answer. You choose one option, and you justify it.

The most important rule is about deadlines. The submission date of a master's thesis is an official date. An extension needs an important reason and a formal decision: the supervisor can extend the period once by one semester, and the Collegium Decanale decides on any further extension ([requirement R-12](../../documentation/requirements.qmd)). A late submission is graded 1. You therefore **never move the official deadline in the plan to absorb a delay**. You move the planned work, you check what still fits, and you record the decision.

## The scenario

::: {.callout-important}
## 16 October 2026 (fictional)

1. **Delay.** The fictional archive delivers the scans two weeks late: on 2027-01-29 instead of 2027-01-15.
2. **Restriction.** The archive restricts reuse of the scans of record **SYN-P021**. They must not appear in any public output.
:::

The restriction is not optional: no public file may contain a scan of SYN-P021. The open question is what this means for the release `v0.1.0-demo` (E08-T3) and for the plan.

## Steps

### Record the two events

::: {.panel-tabset group="route"}

#### Browser

1. Open the epic E08 and click **Create sub-issue**.
2. Create `E08-T6 Receive the scans from the fictional archive` with the label `kind:task` and milestone M2.
3. Create `E08-T7 Exclude the restricted scans of SYN-P021 from public outputs` with the label `kind:task` and milestone M2.
4. Write acceptance criteria for both. Use the [example](#example-acceptance-criteria) below.
5. Open E08-T7 and mark it as **blocked by** E08-T6. You can only exclude scans that you have received.

#### Command line

1. Open a terminal in the folder `projm-thesis`. Define the helper `issue` as in [X3](x3.qmd#before-you-start), if this is a new terminal:

   ```bash
   issue() { gh issue list --state all --limit 100 --json number,title \
     --jq ".[] | select(.title | startswith(\"$1 \")) | .number"; }
   ```

2. Create E08-T6 as a sub-issue of E08 with milestone M2. The body holds the [example acceptance criteria](#example-acceptance-criteria).

   ```bash
   gh issue create --title "E08-T6 Receive the scans from the fictional archive" --label kind:task --parent $(issue E08) \
     --milestone "M2 Data documented and validated" --body "**Acceptance criteria**

   - [ ] The archive delivered every requested scan.
   - [ ] The archive stated the reuse terms per record."
   ```

3. Create E08-T7. It waits for E08-T6, so `--blocked-by` gets the number of E08-T6. You can only exclude scans that you have received.

   ```bash
   gh issue create --title "E08-T7 Exclude the restricted scans of SYN-P021 from public outputs" --label kind:task --parent $(issue E08) \
     --milestone "M2 Data documented and validated" --blocked-by $(issue E08-T6) --body "**Acceptance criteria**

   - [ ] No public file contains a scan of SYN-P021.
   - [ ] The data dictionary explains the restriction."
   ```

:::

### Set the new dates

::: {.callout-note title="Browser only"}
gh can set a field value only with the internal IDs of the Project, the item, the field, and the option. To open your Project from the terminal, run `gh project view 12 --owner @me --web`.
:::

1. In the Project, open the view **Backlog**.
2. Set E08-T6: Start date `2027-01-04`, Target date `2027-01-29` (originally `2027-01-15`).

### Choose one option

Discuss the options with a neighbour for three minutes, or compare them alone. Choose one.

| Option | What you do | What it costs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **A Release 29 records** | Publish the release without the scans of SYN-P021. The data dictionary explains the gap. Mark E08-T3 (release) as blocked by E08-T7. | The release is incomplete. A reuser must read why. |
| **B Release metadata only** | Publish the metadata of all 30 records, but no scans. Update the rights decision (E08-T2). Mark E08-T3 as blocked by E08-T2. | The release is less useful, but complete and simple to check. |
| **C Find a substitute** | Ask a second fictional archive for a comparable record. Create `E08-T8 Obtain a substitute record`, blocked by E08-T6. Mark E08-T3 as blocked by E08-T8. | More work and one more third party. A second delay can push the release towards M3. |

### Apply your option

::: {.panel-tabset group="route"}

#### Browser

1. Create the dependency that your option needs. Option C: create E08-T8 first.
2. Open the view **Roadmap**. Check that E08-T6 and E08-T7 end before the marker of M2 (2027-03-01).
3. If a bar ends after M2, move M2. M2 is a proposed date. Write the reason in the description of M2.
4. Check that M3 (2027-06-01) did not move.

#### Command line

1. Create the dependency that your option needs. Run only the lines of your option.

   ```bash
   # Option A: E08-T3 (release) waits for E08-T7
   gh issue edit $(issue E08-T3) --add-blocked-by $(issue E08-T7)
   # Option B: E08-T3 waits for E08-T2
   gh issue edit $(issue E08-T3) --add-blocked-by $(issue E08-T2)
   # Option C: create E08-T8, blocked by E08-T6; then E08-T3 waits for E08-T8
   gh issue create --title "E08-T8 Obtain a substitute record" --label kind:task --parent $(issue E08) \
     --blocked-by $(issue E08-T6) --body "Find a comparable record in a second fictional archive."
   gh issue edit $(issue E08-T3) --add-blocked-by $(issue E08-T8)
   ```

2. Open your Project with the command below and select the view **Roadmap**. Check that E08-T6 and E08-T7 end before the marker of M2.

   ```bash
   gh project view 12 --owner @me --web
   ```

3. If a bar ends after M2, move M2. M2 is a proposed date. The new description replaces the old one, so keep the justification and add the reason.

   ```bash
   gh api -X PATCH repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones/2 --jq .due_on -f due_on=2027-03-15T12:00:00Z \
     -f description="<old justification> Moved on 2026-10-16: <reason>."
   ```

4. Check that M3 did not move. The result is `2027-06-01T00:00:00Z`.

   ```bash
   gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones/3 --jq .due_on
   ```

:::

### Record the decision

::: {.panel-tabset group="route"}

#### Browser

1. Open `project-management/decisions.md` in your repository and click the pencil icon.
2. Add a record from the [decision template](#decision-text) below at the end. Fill in every line.
3. Commit with the message `docs: record the decision on the delay and the restriction`.

#### Command line

1. Get the latest state from GitHub:

   ```bash
   git pull
   ```

2. Open `project-management/decisions.md` in a text editor.
3. Add a record from the [decision template](#decision-text) below at the end. Fill in every line.
4. Save the file.
5. Save the change as a commit and send it to GitHub:

   ```bash
   git add project-management/decisions.md
   git commit -m "docs: record the decision on the delay and the restriction"
   git push
   ```

:::

### Report the status

::: {.callout-note title="Browser only"}
gh has no command for Project status updates. To open your Project from the terminal, run `gh project view 12 --owner @me --web`.
:::

1. In the Project header, click **Add status update**.
2. Select a status, the start date `2026-10-19`, and the target date `2027-06-01`.
3. Write two sentences: what changed and what did not change. Name the decision D-T02.
4. Click **Post update**.

{{< screenshot x6-status-update >}}

### Optional: export a view

::: {.panel-tabset group="route"}

#### Browser

1. Open the view **Backlog**.
2. Click the arrow next to the view name. Do not use the **View** button.
3. Select **Export view data**.
4. Save the `.tsv` file (tab-separated values). It is a snapshot of the plan for your records or your supervisor. It is not a backup of the Project.

{{< screenshot x6-export >}}

#### Command line

gh cannot export a view with its filters. It can save all items of the Project with their field values as JSON.

1. Save the items as `plan.json` in the folder that contains `projm-thesis`. Use the number of your Project.

   ```bash
   gh project item-list 12 --owner @me --format json > ../plan.json
   ```

The file is a snapshot of the plan for your records or your supervisor. It is not a backup of the Project.

:::

## Texts to copy

### Example acceptance criteria {#example-acceptance-criteria}

```markdown
**E08-T6** Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The archive delivered every requested scan.
- [ ] The archive stated the reuse terms per record.

**E08-T7** Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No public file contains a scan of SYN-P021.
- [ ] The data dictionary explains the restriction.
```

### Decision template {#decision-text}

```markdown
## D-T02 Two-week delay of the scans and a reuse restriction

- **Date:** 2026-10-16 (workshop; fictional)
- **Context:** The fictional archive delivers the scans two weeks late. It restricts reuse of the scans of record SYN-P021.
- **Options considered:** A release 29 records; B release metadata only; C find a substitute.
- **Decision:** Option <A, B, or C>, because <reason>.
- **Changes:** <dates and dependencies that changed, with Issue numbers>
- **Consequences:** <what this means for M2, for the release, and for a reuser>
- **Not changed:** The official submission date (M3, 2027-06-01). An extension needs a formal decision (RSL Phil.-hist. 21 Art. 56).
```

## Expected state

There is no single correct plan. Check your plan against these criteria.

- [ ] E08-T6 and E08-T7 exist; E08-T7 shows "Blocked by: E08-T6".
- [ ] One more dependency follows from your option, and the roadmap shows it.
- [ ] M3 still has the due date 2027-06-01. If you moved M2, its description says why.
- [ ] `decisions.md` holds D-T02 with the option, the reason, the consequences, and what did not change.
- [ ] The Project header shows a status update.

The [solutions](../solutions.qmd#x6) show one possible answer.

## If something goes wrong

| Problem | Cause | Recovery |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A bar ends after the M2 marker. | The delay does not fit. | M2 is a proposed date: move M2 and record why. Never move M3. |
| **Add status update** is missing. | The window is narrow. | Open the Project menu (**…**) or widen the window. |
| **Export view data** is missing. | You opened the wrong menu. | Use the small arrow on the view tab, not the **View** button. |
| You moved M3 by mistake. | — | Set the due date back to 2027-06-01. The Issue history shows the change. |
| Time runs out. | — | Write the decision record first. It is the most important output of X6. |
| A command fails. | Usually the installation, the sign-in, or the folder. | See [Command-line problems](../setup.qmd#command-line-problems), or do the step in the browser. |

## Alternatives

- **Pair:** choose the option together. Then one person edits the Project, the other writes the decision.
- **Private path:** identical. A status update in a private Project is visible only to people with access.
